name: RC-B10-0518/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It condemns Tunisia's detention of lawyer and journalist Sonia Dahmani, arrested in May 2024 after appearing on television. It says she faces repeated trials, could be sentenced to up to 24 years, and is held in poor conditions without proper medical care. The Parliament demands her immediate release, along with others jailed for speaking out, and asks the European Union to put human rights at the centre of its dealings with Tunisia.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only calls for Sonia Dahmani's release and for Tunisia to drop all charges.
- The demands target Tunisia's authorities and affect Dahmani, her sister, and other detainees.
- Next, the Parliament asks European Union bodies to raise these concerns with Tunisia and sends the text to them.
